descriptions: What stands behind a healthy blue Staffy puppy: parents DNA tested clear of L-2-HGA and HC-HSF4, a vet check, a first vaccination and a microchip.
Our health page in full: the two DNA tests and where the parents stand, the eye and knee screening, vaccinations, diet, exercise and warning signs.
Blue Staffy health from the breeder: what we test the parents for, what a puppy has had before it leaves, and how to keep a Staffy well for 12 to 14 years.

brief.goal: Rebuild the health page so that a family choosing between breeders can see, in one pass, exactly what was tested and what the result was — the two DNA tests and the parents' status in a table they can hold a certificate against — and then find the ordinary care that keeps a Staffy well for twelve to fourteen years.
brief.scope: Thirteen sections: hero, four key takeaways, the DNA-test table, the wider screening, vaccinations and paperwork, vet checks and warning signs, diet, exercise, the conditions the breed is watched for, lifespan and registration, one review, a four-row FAQ and a closing CTA carrying the locked prices. All eight migrated images at their original paths; the page carries no embed, because data/facts/blue-staffy-health-uk.json records none.
brief.done: The page states L-2-HGA and HC-HSF4 clear for Maggie and Jones in a table that stacks into labelled rows below 640px, names the BVA/KC eye examination and patella grading, gives the vaccination and microchipping position, the six warning signs, diet, exercise, the five named conditions and the 12-14 year figure attributed to the Staffordshire Bull Terrier Club, carries all eight migrated images at their original paths, shows one review and four FAQ rows, states the locked £1,500 / £1,700 prices and the £500 refundable deposit, names no former city and no health guarantee length, and passes facts-preserved and link parity with nothing missing that `dropped` does not explain.
out_of_scope: the old £850 to £1,200 price band: it is below the locked prices in data/price-matrix.json and data/settings.json (Known Issue 11), and it is listed in `dropped.prices`
a health guarantee of any length: data/settings.json holds guarantee_days: null, so no number may be written (CLAUDE.md rule 9)

the former city and the 'licensed dog breeding establishment' claim attached to it: data/settings.json is Carlisle · Cumbria at town level (Known Issue 16), and the licence wording is LICENCE_CLAIM_PLACEHOLDER until Lisa Bright confirms it
a named testing laboratory: the migrated body names none, and one invented here would be a credential nobody can check
prevalence figures, percentages or a prognosis for any of the five conditions: no file on disk holds one
the newsletter blocks and their '500+ pet parents' claim: no file on disk holds a subscriber count, and `tuple.newsletter` is empty on this record
an enquiry form: the contact page carries the one form the form audit measures, and this page links to it
